title: Nine Desks of Cleaning
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（生活与学习·学校生活）　|　核心词汇：classroom　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 classroom 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1946 my mother was sent to clean ① classroom she could not warm, and she said the cleaning was the whole of the lesson. The ② classroom, meaning the room and not the pupils, was nine desks wide and was cleaned by whoever came last; classroom, she said, is the only thing in a school that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ classroom in that school had the same stove, and the ④ classroom at the end, meaning the one the caretaker kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever cleaned properly. Classroom, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ classroom was the whole of the morning, meaning the lesson it carried and not the room. The ⑥ classroom, meaning the lesson and not any of that, is the only thing in a morning that everybody attends and nobody questions; classroom, he said, is either something you clean or the only word that means both a room and a lesson. She said the lesson is the part they remember.

By 1961 the ⑦ classroom had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the stove. The ⑧ classroom of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine desks and eleven years of cleaning; classroom, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ classroom I remember is the one at the end, which was cleaned in 1966 and is still described as the warmest in the county. A ⑩ classroom, my grandmother said in 1971, is the only thing that improves by being cleaned; every classroom, she said, is a lesson that has agreed to look like a room. She said the lesson was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 教室（指那间屋子本身，与那些学生相对）
C. 固定搭配：clean a classroom 打扫一间教室
D. n. 教室（指那所学校里每一间）
E. n. 教室（指末尾那一间）
F. n. 课堂（抽象：它承载的那节课）
G. n. 那节课（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The classroom, meaning the room and not the pupils
classroom was the whole of the morning
the classroom had become a number in a report
The classroom of the whole thing
A classroom, my grandmother said in 1971

answers.why: clean a classroom 意为“打扫一间教室”，1946 年母亲被派去打扫她烧不暖的那间教室。
classroom 意为“教室”，指那间屋子本身而不是那些学生，宽九张课桌，由最后来的人打扫。
classroom 指那所学校里每一间教室，每一间都是同样的炉子。
classroom 指末尾那一间（校工保留的那一间），是唯一有人认真打扫过的。
classroom 意为“课堂”，抽象指它承载的那节课，父亲说 classroom 就是那个早晨的全部。
classroom 为抽象用法，指那节课本身，是一个早晨里人人都上、却没人质疑的东西。
classroom 意为“教室”，到 1961 年这间 classroom 成了报告里的一个数字。
classroom 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九张课桌和十一年的打扫。
classroom 意为“教室”，我记得的是末尾那一间，1966 年打扫过，至今仍被说成全县最暖的。
classroom 为抽象总称，祖母说一间教室是唯一会因为被认真打扫而变好的东西。
